title: Quiz 3 — Life Science, Cells & Organ Systems
revision: 2026-11 rev2 — 70:30 LOTS:HOTS, balanced choices, in-scope items only

questions.text: Which theme of life explains why you sweat on a hot day?
options: Homeostasis
Heredity
Interdependence
Reproduction

questions.text: Which order shows levels of organization from simplest to most complex?
options: Cell, tissue, organ, organ system
Organ, tissue, cell, organ system
Tissue, cell, organ system, organ
Organ system, organ, cell, tissue

questions.text: Why are the alveoli in the lungs so tiny and numerous?
options: They give a huge surface for gas exchange
They make the lungs heavy enough to stay in place
They store food for the lungs during exercise
They keep dust from ever entering the windpipe
questions.correct: They give a huge surface for gas exchange

questions.text: A smoker's alveoli are damaged, and he tires quickly even when walking. Which chain of effects is MOST accurate?
options: Less gas exchange → less oxygen in blood → less ATP in muscles
More gas exchange → more oxygen → muscles work far too hard
Less blood → more oxygen → muscles stop needing ATP
Damaged alveoli → more carbon dioxide → stronger leg muscles
questions.correct: Less gas exchange → less oxygen in blood → less ATP in muscles

questions.text: A student must diagram how the respiratory and circulatory systems work together. Which link is MOST important to show?
options: Oxygen moving from alveoli into capillaries
Food moving from the stomach into the lungs
Bones storing oxygen for the heart muscles
Nerves carrying blood from the brain to lungs
questions.correct: Oxygen moving from alveoli into capillaries

questions.text: Which organelle builds proteins?
options: Ribosome
Vacuole
Cell wall
Chloroplast

questions.text: Which process moves water across a membrane toward the side with more solute?
options: Osmosis
Active transport
Endocytosis
Photosynthesis

questions.text: About how many ATP does aerobic respiration release from one glucose?
options: About 100

questions.text: Why do muscle cells contain many mitochondria?
options: They need lots of ATP for movement
They store water for the whole body
They make glucose from sunlight
They carry oxygen in the blood
questions.correct: They need lots of ATP for movement

questions.text: Wilted kangkong becomes crisp again after soaking in plain water. Which explanation is correct?
options: Water entered the cells by osmosis
Salt entered the cells by diffusion
Sugar left the cells by active transport
Air entered the cells by endocytosis
questions.correct: Water entered the cells by osmosis

questions.text: Which tissue carries sugar from the leaves to the roots?
options: Phloem
Xylem
Stomata
Root hairs

questions.text: What pulls water up the xylem of a tall tree?
options: Evaporation from leaves (transpiration)
Roots pushing water with strong muscles
Gravity pulling water up from the soil
Sunlight heating the trunk to boil water

questions.text: What is the main job of root hairs?
options: Increase surface area for absorbing water
Make food for the plant by photosynthesis
Carry sugar to the flowers and the fruits
Release oxygen into the soil around them
questions.correct: Increase surface area for absorbing water

questions.text: A tree is girdled — a full ring of bark is removed. The leaves stay green for weeks, but the tree later dies. Why the delay?
options: Xylem still carries water, but roots slowly starve
Phloem still carries sugar, but xylem stops at once
The leaves keep making water for the roots below
The bark grows back quickly and then falls off
questions.correct: Xylem still carries water, but roots slowly starve

questions.text: A gardener waters plants at noon on a hot, windy day, and they still wilt by afternoon. Which advice is BEST?
options: Water in the early morning and add mulch
Water at noon twice as often in the heat
Cut off the roots so the plant needs less
Remove the leaves so it stops making food
questions.correct: Water in the early morning and add mulch

questions.text: Which part of the brain detects changes in body temperature?
options: Hypothalamus
Cerebrum
Cerebellum
Medulla oblongata

questions.text: How does a vaccine protect a person?
options: It trains the immune system to make memory cells
It kills every germ in the body for a whole year
It replaces white blood cells with new medicine
It raises body temperature to burn off all germs
questions.correct: It trains the immune system to make memory cells

questions.text: What happens to skin blood vessels when you are cold?
options: They narrow to keep heat in
They widen to let heat out
They fill with sweat to warm
They burst to release warmth
questions.correct: They narrow to keep heat in

questions.text: Which describes an asthma attack?
options: Bronchioles narrow and breathing gets hard
Alveoli grow larger and hold more air
The heart stops beating for a moment
The trachea fills with blood from the nose
questions.correct: Bronchioles narrow and breathing gets hard

questions.text: A boy gets a fever and his neck lymph nodes swell during a sore throat. What does this show?
options: His immune system is actively fighting an infection
His lymph nodes are storing extra food for later
His nervous system has stopped working properly
His old vaccines have now been completely used up
questions.correct: His immune system is actively fighting an infection
